whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a packages.config with no `targetFramework`.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a packages.config with no `targetFramework`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm packages.config no longer carries a packages.config with no `targetFramework`.
